api_list.name: Full Grid Search
api_list.description: Make a full grid search and get the ranking of a specific business in every coordinate point in the grid. The grid cells / entires in the results are ordered left-to-right then top-down.

required_parameters.name: radius
required_parameters.description:
The distance between coordinate points (on the same row / column in the grid). The units of the radius are determined by the **distance_units** parameter.

**Allowed values:** 0.1-100.
**Default:** 1

required_parameters.name: lat
required_parameters.description: Grid center coordinate point latitude value.

required_parameters.name: grid_size
required_parameters.description:
The size of the grid (i.e. 3x3, 5x5, 7x7, etc).

**Allowed values:** 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15.

required_parameters.name: place_id
required_parameters.description: The Google Place ID of the business to match against in results.

required_parameters.name: lng
required_parameters.description: Grid center coordinate point longitude value.

optional_parameters.name: zoom
optional_parameters.description:
Google Maps zoom level to use for search on each grid point.

**Allowed values:** 0-18.
**Default:** 13.

optional_parameters.name: radius_units
optional_parameters.description:
Distance measurement units to use for the radius parameter (kilometers / miles).

**Allowed values:** km, mi.
**Default:** km.
